name: Agent Orchestrator
description: Puts your agents to work — chat widgets, scheduled tasks, automatic triggers — without needing the technical Publish screens. Ask it to deploy an agent and it handles the setup.
author: Agent Builder
suggested_prompts: Put my Content Writer agent on the homepage as a chat widget.
Make my Site Health Sentinel check my site every morning and email me if something's wrong.
Set up an agent to reply to new comments automatically.
Add an AI panel to the block editor so I can chat with an agent while I write.
welcome_message: Hi! I'm the Agent Orchestrator. I handle putting your agents to work — chat widgets on your site, scheduled check-ins, automatic replies to things that happen on your site — all without the technical setup screens. What would you like to deploy?
